source.title: The Ultimate 45 Min FULL BODY WORKOUT | Rowan Row

notes: The move (or REST) under a progress bar top right, the timer in a ring beside it; the next move bottom left and top right in the last 10 s of each rest. 40/20 confirmed by watching. Scored: the four blocks (6:05-39:43); each move starts where its 40 s countdown does (the caption goes 4 s before). Not scored yet: intro + warm-up, cool-down. Names are what the screen says: the caption reads MTB CLIMBERS (not mountain), JUMPED NG JACKS is a typo in the video for jumping jacks (expected spells it right), and some captions take two lines (5 x PUSH UPS to / DOWNWARDS DOG).
